/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description File paths from external sources without validation can lead to path traversal
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    sink = any(FileSystemAccess fa).getAPathArgument()
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities in file operations where user-controlled paths are used without proper validation

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file creation
 * @description Creating temporary files without proper security can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-temp-file
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["mktemp"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["tmpnam", "tempnam"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Insecure temporary file creation that may lead to race conditions."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure temporary file creation using deprecated functions like mktemp, tmpnam, or tempnam

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition
 * @description Checking file existence before use can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/toctou-race-condition
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode check_call, DataFlow::CallCfgNode use_call
where
  (
    check_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
    check_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["access", "stat"]).getACall()
  ) and
  (
    use_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["remove", "rename", "chmod"]).getACall() or
    use_call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  )
select check_call, "File existence check that may lead to TOCTOU race condition."
findings.hypothesis: TOCTOU race conditions in file operations where existence is checked before use

/**

 * @description Using weak random number generators for security-sensitive operations
 * @kind problem

 * @id py/insecure-random
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-338
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("random").getMember(["random", "randint", "choice", "randrange", "shuffle"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of insecure random number generator. Consider using secrets module for security-sensitive operations."
